gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: Isithombe esikhulu, i-GIF noma ividiyo enesihloko nombhalo phezu kwayo, ebekwe noma kuphi ekhasini.

configure.title: Isithombe noma ividiyo
configure.description: Ifayela le-JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 noma WebM.

configure.title: Umbhalo ongenye indlela
configure.description: Chaza isithombe. Shiya kungenalutho uma singumhlobiso nje.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko esiboniswa phezu kwemidiya. Shiya kungenalutho uma ungasifuni.

configure.title: Umbhalo
configure.description: Umbhalo oboniswa ngaphansi kwesihloko, phezu kwemidiya.

configure.title: Ububanzi obugcwele
configure.description: Yelula kusuka emaphethelweni kuya emaphethelweni esikhundleni sokuhlala kukholomu yokuqukethwe.

configure.title: Ukufaka ohlakeni
configure.description: Ukuthi isithombe sihlala kanjani kusayizi ngamunye wesikrini

advanced.title: Ukufiphala
advanced.description: Umbala obekwe phezu kwemidiya. Uma kunesihloko noma umbhalo uhlala ukhona njalo, ukuze umbhalo uhlale ufundeka.

advanced.title: Iphuzu lokugxila ngokunqamula
advanced.description: Ingxenye yesithombe ehlala ibonakala uma sinqunywa, kusuka ku-0 (kwesokunxele) kuya ku-100 (kwesokudla).

advanced.title: Iphuzu lokugxila ngokwehla
advanced.description: Ingxenye yesithombe ehlala ibonakala uma sinqunywa, kusuka ku-0 (phezulu) kuya ku-100 (phansi).
